principle.mechanism: After a defensive break and pivot, different recovery obligations reacquire at different authored times. New exit-foot contact does not instantly restore orientation, bilateral support, or task authority. Overall readiness becomes true only after every required channel has explicitly rebound.
principle.pocket_rule: LANDING IS NOT READY. REBIND CONTACT, ORIENTATION, SUPPORT, THEN TASK.
principle.statement: RECOVERY READINESS IS A VECTOR, NOT A BOOLEAN.

noodle_queen.notes: Staggered contact/orientation/support/task recovery is visible; displaced guard/stance preserve debt; no reverse interpolation or idle reset.
